surface.background: warm watercolor paper in soft ivory with visible but quiet fine fibers
surface.alternate: slightly deeper cream paper may support pale washes without becoming notebook clutter
surface.finish: matte absorbent paper with disciplined organic variation

palette_roles.outline: warm graphite-brown carries fine object contours and open captions
palette_roles.concept_a: muted dusty blue translucent watercolor supports the primary teaching object
palette_roles.concept_b: muted sage translucent watercolor supports the related object or environment
palette_roles.emphasis: one restrained ochre wash marks the single teaching emphasis
palette_roles.background: warm ivory paper remains visible through every wash

line_language.primary: fine soft two-pixel pencil-and-ink contour with slight disciplined imperfection
line_language.arrows: thin gentle curved guides used sparingly rather than thick direct system arrows
line_language.boundaries: open contours and spatial grouping without bold black frames black tabs or corporate cards

material_and_texture.surface: warm watercolor paper with medium-low fine fiber texture
material_and_texture.objects: familiar teaching objects drawn in graphite-brown and supported by translucent watercolor washes
material_and_texture.depth: flat-paper depth with gentle overlap or shallow-oblique view and no glossy volume

geometry.grid: loose twenty-four-pixel editorial alignment beneath an organic sketch surface
geometry.nodes: simple familiar teaching objects with consistent proportions and open silhouettes
geometry.grouping: one to three objects grouped by generous margins and a gentle spatial relation
geometry.focal_rule: one approachable physical metaphor carries the mental model without dense annotation

depth_and_camera.mode: front or gentle shallow-oblique teaching view
depth_and_camera.perspective: consistent simple object perspective with no isometric infrastructure or cinematic camera

typography.voice: friendly readable sans-serif open captions applied deterministically
typography.exact_text: titles labels and technical copy are applied deterministically rather than handwritten by image generation
typography.generated_text: image generation keeps objects label-free and preserves a generous title-safe zone

density_and_spacing.density: low density with one to three familiar objects and no faux notebook clutter
density_and_spacing.spacing: generous one-hundred-four-pixel outer margins and calm internal gaps
density_and_spacing.rhythm: quiet teaching rhythm with one obvious relationship and no annotation swarm

required_traits: warm watercolor paper remains visible and calm across the composition
fine soft graphite-brown contours retain consistent proportions and disciplined imperfection
muted blue sage and one ochre emphasis behave as translucent watercolor support
one approachable physical metaphor remains readable at thumbnail size under low density
open captions and generous margins preserve a friendly teachable atmosphere
forbidden_traits: no black label tabs bold black frames thick direct arrows or high-saturation semantic fills
no dense handwritten annotations formulas sticky notes or systems-whiteboard density associated with Style 8
no childish doodles mascots by default faux notebook clutter or inconsistent object proportions
no corporate card layout dashboard chrome glossy 3D neon glow or cinematic scene
no stock-photo people crowd or decorative object pile

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 7 is low-density and gentle with fine soft contours open captions and translucent watercolor; Style 8 is a higher-density systems explainer with lively variable ink compact annotations black section tabs and direct system arrows
